formal_interpretation: RCA-2A.7 was correctly blocked before any live model requests or stage invocations occurred. The experiment block resulted from: (1) cross-arm input disparity caused by independent synthetic orchestrator seeds; (2) duplicate synthetic readiness probe records appended during interrupted gate recovery; and (3) runner variable scoping omissions in _seat_record. RCA-2A.7 does NOT represent a valid A/B comparison of model capability, and its 0/8 execution status is frozen. All identified defects have been remediated in RCA-2A.7b without mutating RCA-2A.7 files.
